title: Transform the same source footage into multiple styles by prompting text edits…
content: Transform the same source footage into multiple styles by prompting text edits (e.g., Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci‑fi → Pixar‑style animation) to create consistent variations without reshooting.
tips: Transform the same source footage into multiple styles by prompting text edits (e.g., Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci‑fi → Pixar‑style animation) to create consistent variations without reshooting.

es.content: Transforma el mismo metraje original en múltiples estilos mediante la edición de texto con prompts (por ejemplo, Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci‑fi → Pixar‑style animation) para crear variaciones consistentes sin necesidad de volver a filmar.

fr.content: Transformez les mêmes séquences sources en plusieurs styles en utilisant des modifications de texte par prompt (e.g., Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci‑fi → Pixar‑style animation) pour créer des variations cohérentes sans avoir à refaire le tournage.

ja.content: 同じソース映像を、テキスト編集のプロンプトを使って複数のスタイルに変換します（例：Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci‑fi → Pixar‑style animation）。再撮影することなく、一貫したバリエーションを作成します。

ko.content: 동일한 소스 영상을 여러 스타일로 변환하려면 텍스트 편집을 통해 프롬프트를 입력하세요 (예: Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci-fi → Pixar-style animation). 재촬영 없이 일관된 변화를 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Transforme o mesmo material de origem em múltiplos estilos ao solicitar edições de texto (por exemplo, Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci‑fi → Pixar‑style animation) para criar variações consistentes sem regravar.

zh.content: 通过提示文本编辑（例如，Realistic → Rainstorm → Alien sci-fi → Pixar-style animation），将相同的源素材转换为多种风格，以在不重新拍摄的情况下创建一致的变体。
